$comment: The denominator for input-bench.mjs: the demo variants a shadcn-family input page shows (reui.io/components/input and its neighbours, shadcn/ui's Input, Textarea, Date Picker, Input OTP), and which text field on THESE pages stands for each. A variant with no field is printed as MISSING and lowers nothing — it is the list of what a person coming from that page will not find here. Field ids are `<demo>/<a11y id>`, as the bench prints them. reui.io is refused by this environment's egress proxy, so the variant list is from the shadcn family's published demos rather than a fresh read of that page; it is reviewable data, not a measurement.

variants.note: the label names the field; a11y-label on the box
hint under the field, aria-description on the box
red ring, aria-invalid, the error replaces the hint
no disabled TEXT field on any page — the invoice form's disabled control is a radio
a € prefix inside the box
the reveal toggle is a button living in the field's box
no field with a sibling button that acts on it
one size on every page
no file input; a canvas cannot open the picker without a native control

groups.reference: shadcn/ui components/base number-field (Base UI) · reui.io Input number

variants.note: fm-amount is InputCtl kind=number (a filter); cx-num is NumberCtl, measured against @base-ui/react in ui:number:check

variants.variant: arrow keys step, Shift+Arrow large step
min / max clamped on commit, formatted on blur
default (multi-line, caret moves up and down)
variants.note: InputCtl is single-line; PLAN.md Phase 4 — no component exists
the message demo's composer is drawn, not a field

groups.reference: shadcn/ui Date Picker (react-day-picker in a Popover) · reui.io date picker

variants.note: the field above the always-visible grid; CalendarCtl is measured in ui:calendar:check
the year button and panel, measured against captionLayout=dropdown

variants.variant: picker in a popover (button opens the calendar)
variants.note: the calendar is always on the page; no popover trigger

variants.variant: picker with typed input (parse what is typed)
variants.note: cd-box shows the date; typing into it is not parsed
profile/pf-available is a text field drawn with an icon, and says so
profile/pf-dismissal is a text field with a clock icon; the benchmark is the browser's own <input type=time>

variants.variant: segmented date field (ArrowUp on the month changes the month)
variants.note: profile/pf-birth is a text field; segmented editing declined until measured

groups.reference: shadcn/ui Input OTP (input-otp) · reui.io input OTP

variants.variant: one value, N boxes, paste spreads, Backspace walks back
variants.note: PLAN_INPUTS.md P5b — OtpCtl not written

groups.reference: shadcn/ui Dialog demo (Edit profile: Name, Username)
reui.io tag input · shadcn-family tags input

variants.variant: chips with ×, Backspace at 0 takes the chip
